display_long_description:
The Nightmare Begins
You wake up trapped in a decaying, desolate mansion where every shadow hides a scream. You are not alone. A relentless, headless entity stalks these pitch-black halls, waiting for you to make a single mistake. Do you have the courage to face the absolute darkness, solve the mysteries of the house, and find a way out before you become its next victim?

Built for True VR Immersion
Headless Escape VR is a heart-pounding survival experience rebuilt from the ground up for Meta Horizon. Step into a living nightmare where your real-world instincts dictate whether you live or die.

Full Physical Interaction: Forget buttons. Use your hands to physically turn creaky doorknobs, rummage through dusty drawers for clues, and manipulate intricate mechanisms to unlock secrets.

True Stealth & Hiding System: When you hear it coming, running isn't always an option. Duck into dark closets, peek through the cracks, hold your breath, and stay absolutely still to survive the entity's gaze.

3D Spatial Audio: High-fidelity audio places you directly in the horror. Hear every terrifying footstep, distant whisper, and the scraping of the entity behind you, letting you know exactly which way to run.

Key Features:

Terrifying Visual Atmosphere: High-quality immersive lighting, eerie fog, and realistic textures create a hauntingly beautiful yet deeply unsettling VR environment.
